call_4a.name: submit_answer
call_4a.description: Answer the exam question. Select the options that are correct.

selected.description: The letters of the options that you select. Empty when status is cannot_decide.

reason.description: A short explanation of the selection, or of why you cannot decide.

call_4b.name: submit_check
call_4b.description: Give one result for each of the rules B1 to B6.

finding.description: What is wrong and which option. Null when result is pass.

letter.description: The letter of the option that the finding is about. Null when the finding is not about one option.

point.description: The ID of the guide point that the finding uses, for example 1.2-K2. Null when no point applies.

features.description: Each name of a feature of a Claude product or of MCP that the question, the options or the reasons use. Empty when they use none.
